anomalies.observed: The NAVC HSE crystal HSE2 is connected to nets HSE_IN_NAVC and HSE_OUT_NAVC, but these nets do not include any pins of NAVC1. NAVC1's HSE pins (PH0 pin 5 and PH1 pin 6) are instead connected only to capacitors C37 and C38 on nets Net-(NAVC1-PH0) and Net-(NAVC1-PH1).
anomalies.expected: The 25 MHz HSE crystal must be connected between NAVC1's PH0/PH1 oscillator pins, as specified for both MCUs.
anomalies.impact: The NAVC MCU has no external clock source, so it will not run or will fall back to an internal oscillator, breaking the navigation computer.

anomalies.observed: The BMI088 IMU's PS (protocol select) pin is tied to the +3.3V rail.
anomalies.expected: For I2C operation (as specified: I2C addr 0x19/0x69), PS must be tied low (GND) to select I2C mode.

evidence.quote: IMU (accel + gyro) Bosch BMI088, I2C addr 0x19 (acc) / 0x69 (gyr)

anomalies.impact: The BMI088 will be in SPI mode instead of I2C, so the I2C bus will not communicate with the IMU.

anomalies.observed: The PCA9685 PWM driver's address pin A0 is tied to +3.3V, while A1-A5 are tied to GND.
anomalies.expected: For the specified I2C address 0x40, all address pins A0-A5 must be tied low (GND).

evidence.quote: PWM/servo driver NXP PCA9685PW (I2C 16-ch PWM), I2C addr 0x40

anomalies.impact: The PCA9685 will respond at I2C address 0x41 instead of 0x40, so the flight controller software will not find the PWM driver.
